title: basalt portal verify --json
description: What basalt portal verify --json prints on stdout (CONTRACT.md, CLI): one entry per file the binary embeds, plus any extra file the portal serves, and the check of the embedded pages against the release manifest. Exit 0 when ok is true, 1 when anything differs, is missing, unexpected or could not be checked.

portalUrl.description: The origin that was checked: https://portal.basaltvault.app, or --portal-url.

ok.description: True when every file is OK and the manifest check, when present, is OK.

checked.description: How many files the binary embeds (and so were fetched). files may hold more entries: UNEXPECTED ones.

files.description: One entry per embedded file, sorted by path, then the UNEXPECTED and ERROR entries for paths the build never publishes.

path.description: Relative to the portal origin; approve/index.html is fetched at /approve/.

status.description: DIFFERS: different bytes (SHA-256). MISSING: not served. UNEXPECTED: served but not embedded. HEADER: right bytes, but the Content-Security-Policy differs from the engine's or a .js file is not text/javascript. ERROR: could not be checked (network, HTTP status, a redirect to another origin).

detail.description: Why, when the status is not OK. Names the header for HEADER.

manifest.description: The embedded files checked against a "sha256  path" manifest: the one built into the binary, or --manifest.

mismatches.description: One line per path that differs, is missing from either side, or the parse error.
